channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Malcolm Brogdon | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Malcolm Brogdon from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on Malcolm Brogdon, Payton Pritchard
item.description:
Mazzulla on two Celtics winning 6MOY of the year recently:

“It's a tough thing coming off the bench, especially for Malcolm, who was a starter ...it's tough for Payton too ... when you have a locker room like those guys, you want to do stuff for the guy next to you.”

Joe Mazzulla on Malcolm Brogdon, Payton Pritchard, Apr 23, 2025. Source: Twitter @RealBobManning.

item.title: Corey Kispert on Malcolm Brogdon
item.description:
by teammate Corey Kispert — added five assists.

“When things go awry or things are feeling sticky … Malcolm is a surefire way for us to get back in the groove of what we’re trying to do,”

Corey Kispert on Malcolm Brogdon, Nov 25, 2024. Source: Washington Post.

item.title: Chauncey Billups on Malcolm Brogdon
item.description:
Chauncey Billups:

“I was happy that we stayed put [at the trade deadline]. A lot of people wanted Malcolm, rightfully so. I was one of those people.”

Chauncey Billups on Malcolm Brogdon, Feb 8, 2024. Source: Twitter @highkin.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Malcolm Brogdon
item.description:
Brad Stevens:

“Malcolm (Brogdon) had every right to be frustrated with us in the middle of the summer.”

Brad Stevens on Malcolm Brogdon, Oct 2, 2023. Source: Twitter @BrianTRobb.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on Malcolm Brogdon
item.description:
Joe Mazzulla on whether Malcolm Brogdon will play tonight with his forearm soreness:

“He’s gonna warm up, do his shooting time and see how he feels from there.”

Joe Mazzulla on Malcolm Brogdon, May 27, 2023. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on Malcolm Brogdon
item.description:
Joe Mazzulla on Malcolm Brogdon's injury:

“He gave us the best he could and we went from there.”

Joe Mazzulla on Malcolm Brogdon, May 25, 2023. Source: Twitter @BrianTRobb.

item.title: Marcus Smart on Malcolm Brogdon, Derrick White
item.description:
“Especially when Derrick White is playing the way he’s playing. And Malcolm Brogdon's playing the way he’s playing. And then obviously me getting back to me. I don’t see any three guards that are doing exactly what we’re doing at a very high level every game. So that speaks volumes about us and the pride we are taking on that end.”

Marcus Smart on Malcolm Brogdon, Derrick White, Apr 21, 2023. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on Malcolm Brogdon
item.description:
Boston Celtics:Joe Mazzulla on Malcolm Brogdon:

“He's doing a great job leading that second unit, getting the ball where it needs to go to, and then making plays for himself.”

Joe Mazzulla on Malcolm Brogdon, Nov 9, 2022. Source: Twitter @celtics.

item.title: Marcus Smart on Malcolm Brogdon
item.description:
Between Brogdon’s shooting, passing and ball-handling abilities, Smart saw the attributes the team needed that he can bring to the table and believes he’ll make the game easier for everyone.

“My girlfriend is actually really good friends with his brother’s girlfriend, so I’ve kind of known Malcolm for a while and (he’s a) cool guy,”

Marcus Smart on Malcolm Brogdon, Sep 5, 2022. Source: CLNSMedia.com.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Malcolm Brogdon
item.description:
Keith Smith:Brad Stevens on the Boston Celtics trade for Malcolm Brogdon:

“We are very excited about what Malcolm brings both on and off the court. His resume speaks for itself. He is the kind of playmaker, shooter, and impact defender that we need in our continued pursuit of Banner18.”

Brad Stevens on Malcolm Brogdon, Jul 9, 2022. Source: Twitter @KeithSmithNBA.

item.title: Tyrese Haliburton on Malcolm Brogdon
item.description:
Tyrese Haliburton on playing w/ Malcolm Brogdon:

“Obviously with him just coming back, minutes are still weird because we’re not fully healthy. So just enjoying it while we’re out there together.”

Tyrese Haliburton on Malcolm Brogdon, Feb 26, 2022. Source: Twitter @RomeovilleKid.

item.title: TJ Warren on Malcolm Brogdon
item.description:
Yesterday,I asked Rick Carlisle about the #Pacers’ margin for error w/o Caris LeVert, and about halfway through his response he mentioned T.J. Warren:

“We’re gonna have to hope that at some point sooner than later we can get Malcolm (Brogdon) back and maybe even T.J. Warren.”

TJ Warren on Malcolm Brogdon, Feb 7, 2022. Source: Twitter @RomeovilleKid.

item.title: Nate Bjorkgren on Domantas Sabonis, Malcolm Brogdon
item.description:
J. Michael Falgoust:Bjorkgren on heavy minutes for Sabonis/Brogdon:

“I like the minutes right where they are. It's important how I manage them when we don't play.... Our management of them has been smart. Knowing how long to practice, knowing when to practice.”

Nate Bjorkgren on Domantas Sabonis, Malcolm Brogdon, Jan 25, 2021. Source: Twitter @ThisIsJMichael.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Victor Oladipo, TJ Warren, Malcolm Brogdon
item.description:
J. Michael Falgoust:McMillan:

“I'll be talking with all of our guys, what I saw. I just won't only be talking to Victor. I'll be talking with Malcolm and Warren and Myles on where they think we are.”

Nate McMillan on Victor Oladipo, TJ Warren, Malcolm Brogdon, Jul 28, 2020. Source: Twitter @ThisIsJMichael.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Malcolm Brogdon
item.description:
J. Michael Falgoust:McMillan on Brogdon, who missed time b/c of COVID + injured when season stopped:

“We're still cautious about how we're bringing him back. Right now he's working w/the gold team, which is our 3rd team. In another day or so we'll put him w/the blue team, those starters”

Nate McMillan on Malcolm Brogdon, Jul 16, 2020. Source: Twitter @ThisIsJMichael.

item.title: Cedric Maxwell on Malcolm Brogdon, Jaylen Brown
item.description:
“For him and Brogdon to be able to do that and pull that off is great. One thing with Jaylen Brown is you really see that person, that guy where you go, ‘Man, I really admire what he does from a personal standpoint.’ He gets it and understands who is he is and appreciates his community. For him to do that was special.”

Cedric Maxwell on Malcolm Brogdon, Jaylen Brown, Jun 1, 2020. Source: Boston Globe.

item.title: Nate McMillan on Malcolm Brogdon
item.description:
Scott Agness:Nate McMillan on Malcolm Brogdon exiting the game early:

“His back locked up on him in that first quarter. I think he fell and when he fell, he started feeling spasms.”

Nate McMillan on Malcolm Brogdon, Dec 31, 2019. Source: Twitter @ScottAgness.

item.title: Jon Horst on Tony Snell, Malcolm Brogdon
item.description:
Horst said of Brogdon’s departure.

“Malcolm is a great person and a great player. I wish him the best in Indiana. But I don’t feel like we were forced to do anything that we didn’t want to. We made a trade with Tony Snell that freed us up to match any offers. We have an ownership group that has allowed us to do whatever we need to do [financially]. The decision on Malcolm really came down to what we thought we could get in return. Do we want to pay for what we think his market could be or do we want to see if we could get something that helps us now and going forward?”

Jon Horst on Tony Snell, Malcolm Brogdon, Nov 7, 2019. Source: wapo.st.

item.title: Victor Oladipo on Malcolm Brogdon
item.description:
“I was excited for the opportunity to play with (Brogdon).I know what type of player he is, the level that he plays on and has been playing on the last couple of years from Milwaukee. To have him as an addition is pretty big for us.”

Victor Oladipo on Malcolm Brogdon, Aug 18, 2019. Source: Indianapolis Star.

item.title: Jon Horst on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Malcolm Brogdon
item.description:
Jon Horst:

“I want to give a BIG thank you to our terrific players for their outstanding efforts. Giannis, Khris, Brook, Malcolm and Eric all had incredible seasons and our ‘Bench Mob’ was fantastic all season long. All of our players brought so much excitement to the court and I thank each of them for contributing to our success and embracing our great city and fans.”

Jon Horst on Giannis Antetokounmpo, Malcolm Brogdon, Jun 7, 2019. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Mike Budenholzer on Malcolm Brogdon
item.description:
Bucks coach Mike Budenholzer said after practice Saturday.

“We plan to continue to increase Malcolm's workload and minutes. To say exactly how it's going to play out -- the next step will be him playing a little bit more in Game 1.”

Mike Budenholzer on Malcolm Brogdon, May 11, 2019. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Joe Prunty on Malcolm Brogdon
item.description:
Matt Velazquez:Prunty on Brogdon's calf soreness & being out tonight:

“It was something that we’ve been monitoring and seeing if he was going to be available and we made the decision today.... In terms of the exact moment that it happened I can’t give you that, but we’ve kept an eye on it.”

Joe Prunty on Malcolm Brogdon, Jan 26, 2018. Source: Twitter @Matt_Velazquez.

item.title: Nigel Williams-Goss on Malcolm Brogdon
item.description:
For the older players in the draft who spent four or more years in college, Brogdon's immediate success in the NBA as a 24-year-old rookie who spent five years in college at Virginia is an example they hope to emulate.

“I think Brogdon definitely is the poster boy for us right now as far as some of our older guys coming out,”

Nigel Williams-Goss on Malcolm Brogdon, May 14, 2017. Source: Milwaukee Journal-Sentinel.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Malcolm Brogdon
item.description:
Brian Robb:Stevens on Brogdon:

“He's not a rookie... He knows how to play...he's known how to play for a long time.”

Brad Stevens on Malcolm Brogdon, Mar 29, 2017. Source: Twitter @CelticsHub.

item.title: Jason Kidd on Malcolm Brogdon, John Stockton
item.description:
Charles F. Gardner:Jason Kidd on John Stockton helping the Bucks guards:

“We have Malcolm and Delly. And I told him we have a pretty big point guard, too.”

Jason Kidd on Malcolm Brogdon, John Stockton, Sep 28, 2016. Source: Twitter @cf_gardner.
